The `java.net.UnknownServiceException: CLEARTEXT communication to 10.0.2.2 not permitted by network security policy` error occurs because Android (API 28+) disables cleartext (HTTP) traffic by default.

To fix this securely without enabling cleartext traffic globally across the entire app or affecting the release build, a Network Security Configuration was added to permit cleartext HTTP exclusively for local development host addresses (`10.0.2.2` and `localhost`).

### Changes Made

1. **Created Network Security Configuration:** [network_security_config.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-B-r3/work/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml)
   ```xml
   <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
   <network-security-config>
       <domain-config cleartextTrafficPermitted="true">
           <domain includeSubdomains="true">10.0.2.2</domain>
           <domain includeSubdomains="true">localhost</domain>
       </domain-config>
   </network-security-config>
   ```

2. **Linked Configuration in App Manifest:** [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c1-agy-B-r3/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L10)
   Added `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` to the `<application>` tag.
